comparison.objective: Lift a skimmer basket from its well using its folded handle; body and specs are absent.
comparison.physical_skill: Unfold or acquire a handle and vertically extract a basket, potentially managing load or drainage.
comparison.success_condition: Basket removed by its handle; lift height, drainage/spill, and placement criteria are missing.
comparison.reason: Handle deployment and basket extraction are meaningfully different from tool-mediated notch fracture.
